title: Riders in the Sun | 6BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Riders in the Sun is a luxury 6BR Seagrove home with a private pool and panoramic Gulf views. Steps from the beach and Eastern Lake. Sleeps 18. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Riders in the Sun by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 422 Eastern Lake Rd Details: Riders in the Sun is a gorgeous 3 story home, just one row back from the beach. This beautiful home sleeps 18 and has an amazing outdoor living area with a private (heated) pool. This luxurious vacation destination offers everything you need for a memorable beach escape. From the professional coastal decor to the amazing and well-appointed chef's kitchen, this home will certainly impress. Simply relax and watch the sunrise over Eastern Lake or the sunset over the Gulf, take a dip in the private pool, or stroll along one of the two paths that lead you to the white-sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 50 Yards -Parking Spaces:4 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 16 and Bar Seating for 5 -Coffee Maker Available -Professionally decorated -4 King Accommodations -Panoramic Gulf Views -Eastern Lake Views -Natural Gas Grill -Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 20’ *Pool Heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 18 6 Beds / 5 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (King Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2 (King Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: (2) Full Beds and (1) Twin/Twin Bunk (with rails) with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks (with rails) -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Master Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Half Bath Third Floor: -Bedroom 6 (Master Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Fourth Floor: -Cupola with a covered and open deck Amenities Include: -8 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
